inputs.text: [excited] It was 8 meters long — like two cars, one behind the other! [quickly] Standing up, it was 2.5 meters tall — as tall as a soccer goal! And it weighed 1,600 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as a small car and a cow put together! [excited] And it could run about 32 miles an hour — as fast as a car in the city!
[confident] Really. [proud] The sprinter of the big carnivores of its time.
